CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JULY 24, 2018

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Winterer at 4:31 p.m., on
Tuesday, July 24, 2018, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Ted Winterer
  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis (arrived at 4:42 p.m.)
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Tony Vazquez (arrived at 5:25 p.m.)
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Pam O’Connor

  Absent:  Councilmember Terry O’Day

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:31 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers O’Day, Vazquez, and Mayor Pro
  Tem Davis.

CLOSED SESSIONS  Members of the public Art Casillas and Denise Barton commented on
  closed sessions.

  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:35 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 5:36 p.m., with Councilmember O’Day
  absent, to report the following:
Mayor Pro Tem Davis
arrived at 4:42 p.m.  1.A.  Public Employee Evaluation
  Title: City Manager
Councilmember Vazquez
arrived at 5:25 p.m.  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:36 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Ted Winterer
  Ted Winterer (Nov 20, 2018)

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Ted Winterer
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  July 24, 2018
